g.text: Firmware: set BIASREF_INT = 1 in the same CONFIG3 write that sets PD_BIAS = 1; monitor BIAS_STAT.

g.desc: Firmware: set BIASREF_INT = 1 in the same CONFIG3 write that sets PD_BIAS = 1; monitor BIAS_STAT.

g.text: Do not inject sustained overvoltage or connect a person. RB1/RB2 need pulse- and voltage-rated parts. AVDD back-power not resolved.

g.desc: Do not inject sustained overvoltage or connect a person. RB1/RB2 need pulse- and voltage-rated parts. AVDD back-power not resolved.

g.text: REF is an electrode, not the ADC reference and not GND. Several selected REF branches sum leakage and fault-current paths: evaluate as one system.

g.desc: REF is an electrode, not the ADC reference and not GND. Several selected REF branches sum leakage and fault-current paths: evaluate as one system.

g.text: Lead-lag feedback 1M || (100k + 10 nF C0G) between BIASOUT and BIASINV for >= 47 deg modelled phase margin.

g.desc: Lead-lag feedback 1M || (100k + 10 nF C0G) between BIASOUT and BIASINV for >= 47 deg modelled phase margin.

g.text: RB1 + RB2 (2 x 499k) limit body current; D509 clamps the midpoint to GND.
